changelog_entries.title: Chat SDK adds Instagram adapter
changelog_entries.description: Chat SDK now supports Instagram Direct Messages. Build DM bots with media, quick replies, reactions, and story replies.

changelog_entries.title: Vercel for Platforms can now deploy from your users' GitHub repositories
changelog_entries.description: Pass a short-lived GitHub token when creating a deployment. Vercel uses it to retrieve the source, stores it encrypted, and never saves it on the deployment.

changelog_entries.title: Cline is now available in the AI SDK harness layer
changelog_entries.description: Cline is now available in the AI SDK harness layer through the @ai-sdk/harness-cline adapter, implemented in collaboration with the Cline team. Run it through the same HarnessAgent interface.

changelog_entries.title: GLM 5.3 now available on AI Gateway
changelog_entries.description: Call Z.ai's GLM-5.3 through Vercel AI Gateway with one API key: no markup or platform fee, automatic fallbacks, spend tracking, and traces on every request.

changelog_entries.title: Sign JWTs from your Functions without managing private keys
changelog_entries.description: Vercel KMS lets you sign JWTs and messages from your Vercel Functions with managed keys. Authenticate with your function's OIDC token, keep private keys out of your code, and manage issuers, keys, and grants from the dashboard or CLI. Now in Public Beta.

changelog_entries.title: Deploy Cursor Origin repositories with Vercel in public beta
changelog_entries.description: Connect Cursor Origin repositories to Vercel projects for automatic Preview and Production deployments.

changelog_entries.title: GPT-5.6 Sol is 50% off on AI Gateway for the next month
changelog_entries.description: GPT-5.6 Sol is 50% off on Vercel AI Gateway from August 17 through September 18 on all requests running through AI Gateway.

changelog_entries.title: Encrypted Client Hello (ECH) is now supported on Vercel CDN
changelog_entries.description: Vercel CDN now supports ECH for domains managed by Vercel DNS.
